correctness.rationale: For both untwisted and twisted closures, a single occupied rung separates free longitudinal paths; their matching is forced in synchronized pairs, giving a unique independent-set code. No-rung cases are explicitly exhausted and the exceptional two cannot flip. Every square flip toggles one independent-set bit and conversely, proving the complete reconfiguration graphs. Delete-before-add gives the exact Hamming distance. Disjoint alternating codes achieve diameter, the empty code achieves radius, and coordinate majority proves medianity. Independent direct matching enumeration in Python (n=5..14) and C++17 (n=5..13), including full neighbor-set comparisons and BFS metrics, passed.

originality.rationale: The asserted relationship is for square-flip move graphs of the specific cubic prism and Mobius ladder families, including a parity reversal of frozen states and exact geodesics. Directly inspected Cao–Ren 2016 counts Mobius perfect matchings; Klavzar 2005 establishes the known Lucas-cube metric/median properties; Zigert Pletersek–Berlic 2013 proves a similar abstract graph for cyclic fibonacenes under hexagonal resonance. None of these statements implies the matching-flip adjacency classification for the two cubic ladders without the new direct matching bijection. 2020 Lekshmi–West counts both graph families, so only its abstract was accessible; possible details and unindexed prior analyses are recorded as residual risks, not silently negated.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-order classification of nearest-neighbor perfect-matching dynamics on two canonical periodic cubic graph families. Distinct state counts and Fibonacci/Lucas sequences were already known, but they do not determine ergodicity: a single seam twist reverses whether the parity exhibits two absorbing matchings, even though the entire mobile sector is unchanged. The explicit geodesic formula provides shortest local transformations, and the parity contrast gives an interpretable non-orientability boundary effect. No independent new Lucas-cube theorem is claimed.
